request.text: 中值滤波 median filter 的定义是什么？

reads.text:
Median Filter Reference
SIGNAL PROCESSING - SHAREABLE COURSE FIXTURE
Definition
A one-dimensional median filter replaces the center sample with the median
of an odd-length local window. It is robust to isolated impulse spikes.
Centered-window lookahead
future samples = (W - 1) / 2
Conditions and limits
1. W is a positive odd integer.
2. The formula is lookahead relative to the centered sample.
3. At the boundaries, padding or a restricted valid region is required.
4. This handout gives no numeric noise-reduction percentage.
Worked value
For W = 5, an offline centered window requires 2 future samples.
This is not a universal group delay or peak-delay claim for a nonlinear filter.
See Figure 1 on page 2 for a qualitative impulse-spike illustration.
A03 fixture - page 1 of 2

Impulse-spike illustration
Qualitative schematic; axes and units are part of the source evidence.
(a) Raw signal
Time [ms]
Amplitude [a.u.]
One isolated high spike is visible.
(b) Median, W = 5
Time [ms]
Amplitude [a.u.]
The isolated spike is suppressed.
Figure 1. Median filtering suppresses the isolated impulse spike in this schematic.
The figure supports the qualitative observation only. It does not report a measured
error reduction, frequency response, or causal explanation for another experiment.
A03 fixture - page 2 of 2
